# Odette Pullen

## Overview

- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v2 c4 P0](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0000), [v4 c2 P10](../source/v04-c02.md#nw-v04-c02-p0010)</sub>
- **Role:** Teacher  <sub>[v2 c4 P0](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0000), [v3 c30 P17](../source/v03-c30.md#nw-v03-c30-p0017)</sub>

## Appearance

Odette is a pleasant, rosy-faced woman with plump hands. Her mother noted that she lacks the slim build or high-fashion elegance of others, but her youthful appearance remains intact as she matures.

_Sources: [v3 c39 P20](../source/v03-c39.md#nw-v03-c39-p0020), [v4 c2 P10](../source/v04-c02.md#nw-v04-c02-p0010)_

## Personality

Odette has a relaxed, pragmatic, and mild-mannered temperament. Unbothered by grand ideals of inspiration, her primary focus as a teacher was to merit her pay, satisfy the board, and maintain order—favoring firm punishment when necessary. Though not considered particularly clever, she possesses a gentle, uncorrupted, and thoughtful nature that avoids speaking words that might hurt others' feelings.

_Sources: [v2 c4 P2](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0002), [v2 c4 P4](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0004), [v2 c4 P8](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0008), [v4 c2 P10](../source/v04-c02.md#nw-v04-c02-p0010)_

## Traits

- Pragmatic  <sub>[v2 c4 P2](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0002), [v2 c4 P8](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0008)</sub>
- Mild-mannered and gentle  <sub>[v4 c2 P10](../source/v04-c02.md#nw-v04-c02-p0010)</sub>
- Strict disciplinarian  <sub>[v2 c4 P2](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0002), [v2 c4 P4](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0004)</sub>
- Considerate  <sub>[v3 c8 P13](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0013), [v4 c2 P10](../source/v04-c02.md#nw-v04-c02-p0010)</sub>

## Abilities

- Skilled in domestic cookery  <sub>[v3 c39 P27](../source/v03-c39.md#nw-v03-c39-p0027)</sub>

## Goals

- Earn her living, satisfy the school board, and reach the Inspector's honor roll as a teacher  <sub>[v2 c4 P2](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0002)</sub>

## History

Odette grew up in Brierley as part of a close circle of four friends alongside Nell Harcourt. She joined the Regent's class to qualify as a teacher and began her career instructing pupils at Stonebridge. Later in her youth, her brother Barney persuaded her to convey a proposal of marriage to Nell on his behalf, though Nell rejected the offer. Following a return from the West, Odette became engaged to Mr. Inglis, a wealthy former English miner from Winnipeg. In late May, she married Mr. Inglis and moved with him to live in luxury, traveling to Europe and establishing a home in Winnipeg. Despite her elevated wealth, she remained unpretentious, friendly, and close to her old friends, returning to share enthusiastically in Nell's wedding preparations.

_Sources: [v1 c30 P20](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0020), [v2 c4 P0](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0000), [v3 c8 P1](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0001), [v3 c8 P12](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0012), [v3 c8 P16](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0016), [v3 c39 P20](../source/v03-c39.md#nw-v03-c39-p0020), [v3 c39 P27](../source/v03-c39.md#nw-v03-c39-p0027), [v3 c39 P35](../source/v03-c39.md#nw-v03-c39-p0035), [v4 c2 P10](../source/v04-c02.md#nw-v04-c02-p0010)_

## Background by volume

- Daughter of Mrs. Gorham Pullen  <sub>[v3 c39 P25](../source/v03-c39.md#nw-v03-c39-p0025)</sub>
- Sister of Barney Pullen  <sub>[v3 c8 P5](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0005), [v3 c8 P12](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0012)</sub>
- Attended Brierley school and was part of the Regent's entrance class alongside Nell Harcourt and Hugh Carrow  <sub>[v1 c30 P20](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0020)</sub>
- Initially intended to dedicate her entire life to teaching to maintain financial independence  <sub>[v1 c30 P21](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0021)</sub>
